metadata.title: Probate  Part 5,  " What are Probate Procedures" by James Tanner
metadata.author: BYU Library Family History Center
metadata.shortDescription: This is Part 5 of the Probate series. This is an important part of understaning how probate works and how to find information for your ancestors.

this is part 5 of a series of short

that an administrator first person who

and does an inventory of the state

things that we need to understand about

probate procedures first of all we
understand that laws are made by the
legislature rules are made by
administrative agencies so for example
here the United States legislature would

make rules about how that law is to be

completely separate are the procedures

judges as to how their trials in their
their cases will proceed in their courts

many times the cases are won or lost in

filed the order of the filing what

who won who lost who got clawed if there
